title: Sisyphus prime slap battles script
features:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local AbilityEvent = ReplicatedStorage
	:WaitForChild("SisyphusRemotes")
	:WaitForChild("Ability")

-- Detecta se está no celular/tablet
local isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled

--------------------------------------------------
-- FUNÇÃO PARA USAR HABILIDADE
--------------------------------------------------

local function useAbility(name)
	AbilityEvent:FireServer(name)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CONTROLES DE PC
--------------------------------------------------

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
		useAbility("Solemn")

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then
		useAbility("Rush")

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then
		useAbility("Slam")

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.V then
		useAbility("Destroy")

	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
		useAbility("PhaseTwo")
	end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- INTERFACE MOBILE
--------------------------------------------------

if not isMobile then
	return
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SisyphusMobileControls"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
